n_5f97205461287a19.name: Choose the next email
n_5f97205461287a19.source: export default function next({events,previous}){if(!Array.isArray(events)||events.length>25||events.some(e=>!e||typeof e.messageId!=='string'||!e.messageId))throw Error('Invalid Gmail page');const i=previous?.index??0;if(!Number.isInteger(i)||i<0||i>events.length)throw Error('Invalid email cursor');return {state:{index:i+1},more:i<events.length,messageId:i<events.length?events[i].messageId:''}}

n_377489c80a242f51.name: Check the subject
n_377489c80a242f51.source: export default function message({expectedId,messageId,subject,messageText}){if(messageId!==expectedId||typeof subject!=='string')throw Error('Invalid email identity or subject');const match=subject.includes('Inbound Order');if(match&&(typeof messageText!=='string'||!messageText.trim()))throw Error('Matching email has no text');return {match,subject,body:match?messageText:''}}

n_04ad28047d86c271.name: Validate order lines
n_04ad28047d86c271.source: export default function rows({result}){if(!result||typeof result.purchase_order!=='string'||!result.purchase_order.trim()||typeof result.expected_delivery_date!=='string'||!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(result.expected_delivery_date)||!Array.isArray(result.lines)||!result.lines.length)throw Error('Invalid order extraction');const values=result.lines.map(x=>{if(!x||typeof x.sku!=='string'||!x.sku.trim()||!Number.isFinite(x.quantity)||x.quantity<=0)throw Error('Invalid order line');return [result.purchase_order,result.expected_delivery_date,x.sku,x.quantity]});return {values}}

n_985c1438b5bb25e1.name: Confirm the append
n_985c1438b5bb25e1.source: export default function confirm({updatedRows,values}){if(!Number.isInteger(updatedRows)||updatedRows!==values.length)throw Error('Sheet append result does not confirm all rows');return {}}
